quantize_model_scalar: quantize a fairseq model in place using scalar quantization noise from the model config
create_Quantizer: create a Quantizer instance from a YAML config path with epoch or update scheduling
review_Quantizer_step: review the Quantizer step method to move to the next stage of product quantization
test_Quantizer_begin_epoch: test the Quantizer begin_epoch method to trigger quantization at scheduled epoch boundaries
summarize_Quantizer_state_dict: summarize the Quantizer state_dict and load_state_dict methods for saving and restoring quantization progress
